name: chromosome-cycle-calibration
title: v2ecoli chromosome cycle-time calibration on slow-growth conditions (acetate + glycerol)
description: Carefree investigation tracking v2ecoli chromosome dynamics on slow-growth media. Validates the architectural port (PartitionedProcess -> layered process-bigraph) against vEcoli on acetate, surfaces the upstream FBA-over-supply calibration gap (observed ~80 min cycle vs declared 136 min on acetate), and scaffolds the new glycerol medium (MIX0-845, tau=150 min, CRP-cAMP active). Lives on feat/aim2-dnaa-oric @ b8d0d1e.

at_a_glance.role: Background — why ABT glycerol (Stage 1 chose it for non-overlapping cycles) and why acetate (closest existing v2ecoli condition + has vEcoli implementation for v2ecoli↔vEcoli match). Read this first.
ABT minimal glycerol media (τ=150) + Stage 1 parameter overrides (C=70, D=30, DnaA TE=1, DnaA stable, DARS/datA locations). Prerequisite for Study 1.
dnaA transcription + mRNA + translation + protein-abundance dynamics (new mechanism on top of Study 0's baseline). Active phase once Study 0 closes.
DnaA-ATP intrinsic hydrolysis at 0.046 /min. Boesen 2024 ratio check (0.2-0.5).
307 chromosomal DnaA boxes + oriC + dnaAp. Two-step oriC fill prediction.
Replaces inherited Donachie/initiation-mass trigger with mechanism. Targets the failed cycle-time acceptance criterion.
Extrinsic DnaA-ATP/ADP conversion. RIDA, DDAH, DARS1+DARS2. Knockout sweep + synchrony.
SeqA cooperative binding at oriC + dnaAp. Eclipse-period regulator.
Broadens cooperativity treatment beyond SeqA. DnaA-DnaA filament + box cooperativity.
End-to-end validation across growth rates + perturbations.

how_to_read: **Acceptance criteria — current status:** five lifecycle checkpoints. D-period wiring (passed), v2ecoli↔vEcoli match (passed), multi-gen equilibration to declared τ (**failed**, upstream FBA gap), TF coverage audit (open, GlpR gap), glycerol medium added (passed). The failed criterion is the active research question — Study 4 (`dnaa-04-mechanistic-initiation`) is what closes it.

**How the per-phase studies fit:** `chromosome-replication-plan.pdf` breaks this work into Studies 1-8 with a linear dependency chain. Study 1 (DnaA expression dynamics) is the active phase. Subsequent studies activate as each prerequisite closes its primary tests.

**Where the heavy artifacts live:** Sim DBs (`out/acetate_apr24_test.db` 9.1 GB, `out/glycerol_stage1_1gen.db` 14 GB, `out/vecoli_acetate_compare_parquet/` 677 MB) are in this worktree only (~23 GB total). Not duplicated to v2ecoli-dashboard. See the Inputs tab for the full dataset catalog.

glossary.definition: The fixed-duration period after replication finishes during which the cell completes septation and divides. In v2ecoli, declared as 30 min for slow growth (matches vEcoli).
The time taken to replicate the chromosome end-to-end. Declared as 70 min for slow growth.
Mass-doubling time for the medium. ABT minimal acetate τ=136 min (declared); ABT minimal glycerol τ=150 min (declared). Both currently observed to cycle ~80-120 min in practice on this branch.
A guard / condition variant in v2ecoli that supplies amino acids exogenously. Used as a sanity baseline (cycle ~45 min unfixed → 22.5 min once D-period is wired).
Regulatory Inactivation of DnaA. Hda + β-clamp drive DnaA-ATP → DnaA-ADP hydrolysis after replication, preventing re-initiation.
Intrinsic DnaA-ATP Hydrolysis (~0.046 /min). DnaA-ATP slowly self-hydrolyzes independently of RIDA.
DnaA-Reactivating Sequences at two chromosomal loci. Exchange ADP→ATP on DnaA, counteracting RIDA + DDAH.
EcoCyc identifier for ABT minimal + 0.2% glycerol media (13 mM GLYCEROL). Newly added in this branch.
The reference commit on branch dnaa-replication-studies used for comparison. Our overrides (C/D periods, dnaA TE, DARS widening) are applied at a different pipeline stage than upstream.

biological_story: E. coli MG1655 on ABT minimal glycerol (tau=150 min target per Fu/Xiao/Jun 2023 heuristic) and minimal acetate (tau=136 per condition_defs.tsv) is supposed to grow slowly with non-overlapping cell cycles. v2ecoli + vEcoli both run these conditions at ~80 min cycle with multi-fork replication (4 oriCs, 3 active forks at division for glycerol). Cause: FBA over-supplies amino acids in early gen -> tRNAs stay 97-98% charged -> SpoT degrades ppGpp -> ribosomes elongate at 21 aa/s -> mass grows ~3x in 80 min -> D-period trigger fires early. Multi-gen does not wash this out. The cell cycle bouncing is upstream of the v2ecoli port (wcEcoli-inherited) and downstream of the FBA biomass objective calibration.
question: Does v2ecoli reproduce vEcoli chromosome cycle dynamics on slow conditions, and at what point in the simulator stack does the observed-vs-declared cycle-time gap originate?
hypothesis: Confirmed today: v2ecoli reproduces vEcoli's acetate dynamics within ~15 uM ppGpp and ~3% charged-fraction across gen 1. The gap (observed ~80 min vs declared 136 min) is wcEcoli-inherited (FBA over-supplies AAs in early gen -> tRNA stays 97-98% charged -> SpoT degrades ppGpp -> ribosomes elongate fast). Rejected: multi-gen does NOT equilibrate to tau=136 (5-gen lineage cycles 42-82 min, no monotonic trend).

studies.name: dnaa-context-condition-landscape
studies.question:
What media conditions exist in v2ecoli, why does ABT minimal glycerol matter for the
DnaA arc, and what role does acetate play in our validation pipeline?

findings.statement:
**[Framing established]** Three takeaways now in one place — (1) v2ecoli's 5 canonical
conditions max out at acetate τ=136; none are ABT glycerol. (2) The Stage 1 PDF chose ABT
glycerol τ=150 specifically to avoid multi-fork replication and the synchronization artefacts
that come with it. (3) Acetate is the v2ecoli ↔ vEcoli equivalence reference because it's
the closest non-multi-fork existing condition AND has an established vEcoli implementation
for side-by-side comparison; glycerol is the Stage 1 deliverable.

evidence.note: Documentary finding — no underlying simulation. The artifact is hand-authored from earlier baseline simulations in this worktree's out/ directory.

studies.name: dnaa-00-stage1-baseline
studies.question:
Does v2ecoli, with the Stage 1 parameter overrides applied to a glycerol cache, produce a
stable single-generation cell cycle near τ=150 min with the prescribed C=70 / D=30 timing,
DnaA TE=1, DnaA fully stable, and the canonical chromosomal locus locations? Separately —
does the v2ecoli refactor reproduce vEcoli's behaviour on the established acetate reference
condition?

findings.statement:
**[Deliverable]** Glycerol Stage 1 single-gen runs at 121 min — within the ±20% tolerance
of declared τ=150. All six Stage 1 parameter overrides (C=70 via replisome_rate, D=30 via
build_cache.py, dnaA TE=1.0, dnaA stable, DARS1+DARS2 windows widened, DATA row added)
apply cleanly on the glycerol cache. This is the Stage 1 baseline that Study 1 builds on.

**[Cross-codebase equivalence]** v2ecoli reproduces vEcoli's behaviour on the established
acetate reference condition. Single-gen acetate match is within ~15% on ppGpp, charged-fraction,
ribosome elongation rate, and cell mass. Acetate is used here for vEcoli equivalence only —
the actual Stage 1 baseline (glycerol) doesn't have a side-by-side vEcoli implementation to
compare against.

**[Infrastructure fix]** D-period division trigger is correctly wired in v2ecoli. The fast
`with_aa` condition's observed cycle dropped 45 → 22.5 min after MarkDPeriod.divide was wired
in, matching vEcoli within rounding. (`with_aa` is a third condition used as an unrelated
sanity baseline — neither the deliverable nor the diagnostic; it's the strongest signal for
"is the D-period trigger firing on time?" because its short cycle makes the fix highly
visible.)

**[Upstream context — refutes a hypothesis]** Multi-gen acetate lineage does NOT monotonically
equilibrate toward declared τ=136. The 5-gen run cycled 42 / 81 / 61 / 82 / 60 min — no trend.

Why acetate, not glycerol, for this test — acetate is where the observed-vs-declared gap is
most documented (~80 min observed vs 136 min declared on the canonical cache), inherited from
wcEcoli. The candidate hypothesis was that the gap is a transient ParCa-initial-state artefact
that multi-generation propagation would wash out. It isn't.

Implication — the gap is mechanistically caused (FBA over-supplies amino acids early in gen →
tRNAs stay 97-98% charged → SpoT degrades ppGpp → ribosomes elongate at 21 aa/s → mass
triples in 80 min → D-period trigger fires early). This is the wcEcoli-inherited problem the
chromosome-cycle-calibration investigation surfaces; it does NOT block the glycerol Stage 1
baseline from being delivered (F-S1), and it does NOT block Study 1 (DnaA expression
dynamics, parameter-only on top of Study 0). Its proposed closure lives at Study 4
(mechanistic initiation, replacing the inherited Donachie / initiation-mass trigger).
findings.expected: Lineage cycle times should trend toward τ=136 declared as the cell state equilibrates.
findings.observed: 42 / 81 / 61 / 82 / 60 min — no monotonic convergence; large gen-to-gen oscillation.
findings.next_action: Active research direction — Study 4 (mechanistic initiation). No action required at Study 0.

studies.name: dnaa-01-expression-dynamics
studies.question: Can v2ecoli reproduce realistic DnaA mRNA and protein dynamics under steady slow growth — DnaA count in the mass-spec / EcoCyc range, mRNA + protein concentrations stable within ~10%, and autorepression behaviour when DnaA is artificially over-supplied?

studies.name: dnaa-02-atp-hydrolysis
studies.question: With ONLY intrinsic DnaA-ATP hydrolysis (no RIDA / DDAH / DARS), can v2ecoli maintain DnaA-ATP / total-DnaA in the expected 0.2-0.5 range reported by Boesen et al. 2024 (PNAS, Delta4 cells)?

studies.name: dnaa-03-box-binding
studies.question: With DnaA box binding wired in, does v2ecoli show the expected two-step oriC occupancy pattern — chromosomal boxes fill first, then oriC fills once chromosome sites are saturated? Does free DnaA increase after titration completes, just before initiation?

studies.name: dnaa-04-mechanistic-initiation
studies.question: Does mechanistic initiation produce stable cell-cycle behaviour (initiation roughly once per generation) with replication times in a narrow distribution? And does it reproduce the upstream observation that fast growth correlates with early replication?

studies.name: dnaa-05-rida-ddah-dars
studies.question: Do the extrinsic conversion mechanisms (RIDA, DDAH, DARS1, DARS2) produce stronger initiation synchrony than the intrinsic-only Study 2 model, and do they reveal DnaA-ATP concentration oscillations across the cell cycle?

studies.name: dnaa-06-seqa-sequestration
studies.question: Does adding SeqA sequestration prevent the back-to-back re-initiation events that Study 4 / 5 might otherwise allow at fast growth rates?

studies.name: dnaa-07-cooperativity
studies.question: Designed when this study activates after prerequisites close.

studies.name: dnaa-08-validation
studies.question: Designed when this study activates after prerequisites close. Likely — does the integrated DnaA / replication-initiation model reproduce known experimental observations across the cell-cycle phenotype space?
